detector_model: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN V2 (Pretrained on MS COCO 80 categories)

evaluation_taxonomy.description: Pedestrians, runners, children, and dismounted vehicle occupants in the driving environment.
Four-wheeled or multi-wheeled motor vehicles, including passenger cars, vans, trucks, and buses.
Two-wheeled traffic participants including bicycles and motorcycles, with or without riders.
Stationary or tumbling road obstacles, construction barriers, fallen cargo, traffic cones, and debris.

Regions where object presence or identity is fundamentally undecidable by a human auditor (e.g., severe distant occlusion, motion blur). Unmatched predictions overlapping these regions with IoU >= 0.50 are absorbed without FP penalty.

person.description: Standard COCO person detection directly maps to evaluation taxonomy person.

car.description: COCO car maps to vehicle taxonomy.

truck.description: COCO truck maps to vehicle taxonomy.

bus.description: COCO bus maps to vehicle taxonomy.

bicycle.description: COCO bicycle maps to bicycle_or_motorcycle taxonomy.

motorcycle.description: COCO motorcycle maps to bicycle_or_motorcycle taxonomy.

road_debris_or_prop.rationale: MS COCO contains 80 standard categories, none of which correspond to road debris, spilled cargo, fallen tree limbs, or generic highway obstacles. By formally mapping zero COCO classes to road_debris_or_prop, the evaluation framework ensures that the pretrained detector's inherent blindness to obstacles is accurately penalized as structural False Negatives (FN), preventing unearned safety claims.

unsupported_coco_classes.description: COCO categories outside traffic participants (e.g., traffic light, bench, fire hydrant, cat, dog) map to unsupported_or_other. If predicted by the model, they cannot match any ground truth traffic targets and will be evaluated as False Positives (FP) unless absorbed by an ignore_ambiguous box.

matching_rules.mismatch_policy: Spatial IoU overlap >= 0.50 between a prediction and a ground truth object of differing taxonomy classes is strictly rejected as a match. The prediction is evaluated as an FP for its predicted class; the ground truth object remains unmatched as an FN for its true class.
